confidence: High for the concrete current edges below; this is not an exhaustive proof that every imaginable ordinary-only refactor is impossible.
summary: The accepted ordinary prefix is real and complete within its declared bounds. Remaining meaningful work is same-invocation source/projection/write-return history and its actual owner/consumer, not relocating already named policy helpers. A useful source/design closure is ZIP-independent now. A retained ordinary producer could subsequently be an explicit prerequisite, but a DTO or pass-through lease helper without an actual consuming lifecycle is not full3e progress or authority.
currentEvidence: Retain accepted ordinary45 plus separately accepted protectedLate2. No old raw, package, native test or counts were replayed.

confirmedEdges.fact: Every successful scope still obtains guardian policy, performs structured current/original extraction and aliases/action reads, builds conditional original contexts, calls existing ActorBrain and six selected Full audits. The public API selects Full; emptiness does not skip these dependencies.

NPC original lookup sits inside its broad catch; residents normalize current then read/normalize original inside one catch; entity/Shining original reads precede their parse catches. Hoisting, batching, caching or conflating these reads changes ordinary behavior.

Detached resident normalization fills missing UTC receipt/history fields. Current/original NormalizeShape invocations at N954/978 are distinct real first passes; current normalized bytes cannot reconstruct those earlier outputs.

Actual Full builds a new guardian context outside the earlier game-state cache lifetime. Completed-musings comparison is outside the broad domain catch; identity/quest/authority/power/reasoning construction follows, including a conditional second authority-root build.

Provided-lease ReadForComparisonAsync already exists. The missing observed adapter must cover MatchesAsync original reads and binding reads plus current published-hash/JSON comparison. Default ordinary wrapper owns acquisition/physical close; its null/disabled/mismatch and storage/close outcomes cannot be merged. Another overload alone is redundant.

Real ordinary validation returns issues and bool; it does not retain a same-invocation projection/read/write-return history. Repair invalidates completed scopes before mutation; a future retained pass needs exact route/iteration/owner/generation invalidation rather than global cached authority.

Corrected joint canonical refresh publishes through its dedicated path and returns to post-publication validation before the later ordinary loop at1095. An ordinary pass there is not necessarily a prepublication pass for this branch.

Existing capture retains specific original-read evidence, then irrevocably closes Capturing. Canonical publisher47–48 calls that close before preparation. An adapter attached after return is too late; invoking mutating validators under the publication lease to fabricate missing history is not allowed.

Truly uncovered original actor-memory data may remain usable-null policy; indexed/baseline-tracked but unregistered, registered missing/unreadable/hash-mismatched originals produce issues. Do not turn policy-null into authenticated absence or strengthen the ordinary rule.
The real post-publication continuation calls public Full at99. New changes to that common orchestration must account for the genuinely affected protectedLate2, separately from ordinary controls.

Pin fixed source roles and each occurrence/catch boundary, including nested original callbacks/control/rollback, exact current-vs-original policies, same-generation drift and end-rechecks. Missing/caught-source evidence stays unavailable without a new ordinary rejection.

Define repair iteration, source replacement/generation, missing pass, scope disablement and original-route invalidation; no holding a canonical lease across a model/worker wait.

Identify where a genuine consumer may inspect this retained pass. For the corrected-joint path with no prior pass, explicit MissingOrdinaryObservation/ProjectionRequired is future family disposition, not permission to rerun mutating validators or to alter current ordinary v2 acceptance.
Keep HOT source issue/fullS, B/M3 publication and cold import inactive. Any eventual consuming join must occur while the same actual attempt is still Capturing, before CloseCapture/preparation.
